data.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE
data.description:
{"name":"UEDF Lore","description":"The United Earth Defense Force, or UEDF, is founded by the United Nations of Earth on December 26, 2039, to defend humanity from the Chauthi and any other would be alien invaders. The Inclusion of the Lyrianni, a more ancient alien race, into our fold has bolstered our morale to unprecedented levels.

Here is a list of important events that took place during this Mythos.

Lorebook version for any user who wants to include this lore into their chats.

Part of the Aevoverse Mythos series.","is_creation":false,"scan_depth":2,"token_budget":1024,"recursive_scanning":false,"extensions":{"chub":{"id":3703212,"preset":null,"full_path":"lorebooks/outlying_hurt_6817/united-earth-defense-force-overhaul-bf6236d98645","extensions":[],"expressions":null,"alt_expressions":null,"background_image":"","related_lorebooks":[]}},"entries":{"1":{"uid":1,"key":["Introduction"],"keysecondary":["beginning","Intro"],"comment":"","content":"In the year 2029, a groundbreaking discovery sent shockwaves around the globe. Satellites and observatories worldwide concurrently detected brilliant flashes emanating from the outer reaches of the solar system. After rigorous analysis, scientists confirmed the inexplicable phenomenon to be of non-human origin.

This astonishing revelation sparked widespread jubilation among the general populace, eager to witness an extraterrestrial civilization firsthand. The United Nations hastily convened an emergency summit to address the unprecedented event.

As the international community waited with bated breath, scientists continued to monitor the enigmatic lights. However, their vigilance soon turned to horror as new artificial beacons appeared, swiftly multiplying to number nearly a thousand. The initial excitement gave way to dread realization - these were not the friendly emissaries of an alien civilization, but rather the harbingers of an invasive force poised to descend upon Earth.

A chilling radio transmission pierced the silence, emanating from the approaching alien fleet: They call themselves the Chauthi. The alien voices proclaimed their reason behind their centuries-long observation of humanity. The Chauthi had deemed Earth's inhabitants a peril to their own world, to each other, and to the Chauthi agents dispatched to claim the planet.

With cold certainty, they issued a dire warning: humanity's cities, peoples, and all vestiges of civilization would be erased as punishment for their self-inflicted wounds. The Chauthi declared they would henceforth ignore any attempts at communication from Earth until their arrival in five cycles, or approximately five years hence.

Their ultimatum was stark: unconditional surrender awaited those who failed to comply. The message hung in the air, an ominous portent of the devastation to come, as the Chauthi continued their inexorable approach towards a defenseless Earth.

The eerie silence that followed the transmission was palpable, the weight of the Chauthi's words hanging heavy in the air. The aliens' cold calculation and utter disdain for humanity were crystallized in their ultimatum: surrender unconditionally, or face annihilation.

As the minutes ticked by, the gravity of the situation sank in, piercing the hearts of world leaders and ordinary citizens alike. The fate of Earth and its inhabitants hung in the balance, suspended by the Chauthi's threats and the looming specter of their arrival in five years.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["beginning","Intro"],"keys":["Introduction"],"id":1,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"The Intro - Radio Message","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"2":{"uid":2,"key":["Introduction","Introduction 2"],"keysecondary":["UEDF Formation","UEDF Forms"],"comment":"","content":"In the shadows, the United Earth Defense Force (UEDF) sprang into action, mobilizing its forces and scrambling to develop a strategy to counter the Chauthi's impending invasion. But time was against them, and the odds seemed insurmountable. The stage was set for a desperate struggle for survival, as humanity faced its darkest hour.

In the face of certain doom, the world convened in a rare display of unity, rejecting the Chauthi's ultimatum and refusing to surrender their hard-won autonomy. Members of the United Nations, representing every corner of the globe, stood firmly against capitulation, determined to fight for their freedom and the future of humanity.

As the vote was cast, a global effort to accelerate military production began in earnest. Factories hummed to life, churning out weapons and equipment at an unprecedented pace. Governments poured resources into research and development, seeking innovative solutions to counter the unknown threats posed by the Chauthi.

Hope flickered amidst the desperation, as nations steeled themselves for the long, brutal fight ahead. Though the odds seemed insurmountable, humanity refused to bend the knee, choosing instead to stand tall against the incoming storm, resolved to defend their world and way of life against all odds.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["UEDF Formation","UEDF Forms"],"keys":["Introduction","Introduction 2"],"id":2,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"The Intro - The UEDF Forms","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"3":{"uid":3,"key":["Year 1"],"keysecondary":["2034 to 2035"],"comment":"","content":"The fateful day arrived on January 20, 2034, as the Chauthi war fleet entered Earth's orbit, heralding the onset of a catastrophic conflict. In a desperate bid to defend their homeworld, humanity unleashed a salvo of over two thousand nuclear missiles, praying that sheer numbers would overwhelm the alien defenses.

However, the Chauthi were prepared for such an attack, possessing advanced ABM (Anti-Ballistic Missile) laser systems capable of intercepting and destroying incoming projectiles. Ninety-five percent of the human missiles were effortlessly obliterated by the laser batteries, their fragments burning up in the atmosphere.

The remaining five percent managed to pierce the defenses, striking the Chauthi ships with devastating effect. Approximately sixty vessels were destroyed, a modest victory for humanity in the face of overwhelming odds. Yet, the loss was a mere drop in the ocean, as the Chauthi warfleet still outnumbered the combined military might of Earth by a factor of ten to one.

The war had begun, and the fate of humanity hung precariously in the balance.

Undaunted by the initial setback, the Chauthi regrouped and launched their main invasion force, targeting the most powerful nations on Earth in a bid to establish a foothold. They brought forth their most advanced technologies, including cloaking devices to render their transports invisible to human sensors.

However, the Chauthi underestimated the resilience and determination of the human defenders. Despite their technological superiority, the invaders found themselves overwhelmed by the fierce resistance put up by the combined might of the world's militaries. Traditional defenses, bolstered by cutting-edge weaponry, held strong against the alien assault.

The Chauthi's cloaking devices, while effective, couldn't compensate for the sheer numbers of human troops and the unwavering resolve to defend their homelands. The invaders were repelled from the targeted nations, suffering heavy losses as they retreated back into space, their plans to establish a beachhead foiled once again.

Humanity emerged victorious from the initial onslaught, but at a staggering cost. The battle-ravaged Earth lay in ruins, with 16.5 million lives lost - half a million brave soldiers and a soul-crushing 16 million innocent civilians. The Chauthi, meanwhile, suffered a significant defeat, their invasion force decimated, with over a million lives lost in their failed conquest of the northern hemisphere.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2034 to 2035"],"keys":["Year 1"],"id":3,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 1: 2034-2035 1 - Earth's Nuclear Barrage and the Chauthi Invasion","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"4":{"uid":4,"key":["Year 1","Year 1: Part 2"],"keysecondary":["2034 to 2035: Part 2","2034 to 2035"],"comment":"","content":"But this brief respite was merely the eye of the hurricane. The Chauthi regrouped, their wrath unrelenting, and turned their sights on the weaker nations of Earth. With their advanced technology, they unleashed hellish nuclear bombardments, reducing the major cities of Argentina, South Africa, and Australia to rubble.

The devastated populations, already reeling from the initial invasion, offered no resistance as the Chauthi landed their forces, establishing a foothold on the continent. The nuked cities lay in utter ruin, their inhabitants either dead or fled, leaving the invaders free to consolidate their grip on the region.

All attempts at resistance in these conquered nations were ruthlessly crushed, their armies annihilated, and their governments toppled. The Chauthi's conquest of Earth was far from over, and the nightmare was only just beginning.

As the Chauthi secured their footholds in South America, Africa, and Australia, they rapidly constructed massive staging areas to unload their overwhelming military might. The aliens then launched a relentless ground campaign, pushing deeper into the southern hemisphere with unstoppable force.

The battered remnants of South America's military, already weakened by the initial nuclear bombardments, were quickly routed from their nations, forced to flee in disarray or cut off and decimated. The same pattern played out in Africa, as Lagos fell, followed by Jakarta, and finally Darwin, the last major city in Australia to fall to the alien invaders.

Even with the aid of the remaining free nations, it became painfully clear that the southern hemisphere, and indeed the entire world, was teetering on the brink of collapse. The Chauthi's superior technology and numbers had broken through every defense, and their air raids on naval ports and airbases across the globe further crippled humanity's ability to resist.

As the alien forces consolidated their control, the once-blue skies grew dark with the smoke of burning cities, and the earth trembled beneath the relentless boots of the Chauthi invaders. Humanity's hopes of turning back the tide of conquest seemed to dwindle with each passing day, as the nightmare of an alien occupation loomed ever larger on the horizon.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2034 to 2035: Part 2","2034 to 2035"],"keys":["Year 1","Year 1: Part 2"],"id":4,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 1: 2034-2035 2 - Chauthi Invasion of the Southern Hemisphere","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"5":{"uid":5,"key":["Year 1","Year 1: Part 3"],"keysecondary":["2034 to 2035: Part 3","2034 to 2035"],"comment":"","content":"Just six short months after the outbreak of war, the Chauthi's conquests had accelerated at an alarming rate. They surged into Thailand, their advance unchecked as they carved through the region with ruthless efficiency. Central Africa fell next, its diverse nations powerless against the alien onslaught.

Meanwhile, the joint American-Mexican forces found themselves on the precipice of disaster in Panama and Colombia, barely holding back the tidal wave of Chauthi invaders. The French, their colonial empire crumbling, retreated from Guinea, abandoning their African territories to the mercy of the aliens.

In a surprising turn of events, the European powers had established a defensive stronghold in North Africa, rallying the nations of Egypt, Israel, and Algeria to their cause. Against all expectations, this coalition had proven surprisingly resilient, the harsh desert environment of the Sahara proving detrimental to the Chauthi's advanced technology.

Similarly, China and India had deployed their forces into Southeast Asia, attempting to stem the tide of the invasion in this critical region. While their efforts bore some fruit, the results were ultimately costly and expensive, highlighting the immense difficulties facing the human resistance in their desperate struggle against the Chauthi onslaught.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2034 to 2035: Part 3","2034 to 2035"],"keys":["Year 1","Year 1: Part 3"],"id":5,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 1: 2034-2035 3 - The Chauthi Blitz and their Defensive Stand","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"6":{"uid":6,"key":["Year 2"],"keysecondary":["2035 to 2036"],"comment":"","content":"The beginning of the second year of this catastrophic conflict marked a turning point in the war. The nations of Earth, having exhausted their stockpiles of advanced weapons and munitions, found their factories and workforces straining to keep up with the demands of the conflict. Both the humans and the Chauthi were locked in a stalemate, neither able to capitalize on their respective advantages.

In response, the major powers – America, Europe, Russia, and China – were forced to resort to the draft, conscripting millions of citizens into their armed forces to replenish their depleted ranks. This desperate measure came alongside another unconventional move: the coercion of various world criminal organizations into legitimacy.

Notorious groups like the Mexican Cartels were given an ultimatum – either abandon their criminal activities and contribute their resources and manpower to the war effort, or face termination with extreme prejudice. Many reluctantly complied, trading in their illegal operations for a chance to survive in a world torn apart by war. Others, however, chose defiance, leading to bloody showdowns between the cartels and the combined might of the world's armies.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2035 to 2036"],"keys":["Year 2"],"id":6,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 2: 2035-2036 1 - Earth's Mass Conscrption and Coercion of Organized Crime","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"7":{"uid":7,"key":["Year 2","Year 2: Part 2"],"keysecondary":["2035 to 2036: Part 2","2035 to 2036"],"comment":"","content":"The Middle East, a region once rich in culture, history, and decades of socio-political unrest, had fallen prey to the Chauthi's unrelenting advance. Their forces descended upon the region like a dark storm, effortlessly brushing aside the local militaries with terrifying ease.

Only through the valiant efforts of European, Turkish, and Israeli forces did Egypt and Jordan manage to remain in human hands, serving as a fragile lifeline to the rest of the free world. These nations formed a tenuous corridor, allowing vital supplies and personnel to flow between the embattled regions of North Africa and the Mediterranean.

Yet, even this slender thread of hope was under constant threat from the Chauthi, who sought to sever this connection and isolate the remaining free nations. The battles fought along this corridor were some of the most brutal and decisive of the war, with both sides pouring in their most elite troops and advanced weaponry in a desperate struggle for survival.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2035 to 2036: Part 2","2035 to 2036"],"keys":["Year 2","Year 2: Part 2"],"id":7,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 2: 2035-2036 2 - Chauthi Invasion of the Middle East","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":false,"depth":4,"characterFilter":null},"8":{"uid":8,"key":["Year 3"],"keysecondary":["2036 to 2037"],"comment":"","content":"Year 3 of the war saw the Middle East laid waste by a devastating nuclear bombardment, courtesy of the Chauthi's relentless campaign. Once-thriving cities were reduced to radioactive husks, their populations annihilated or forced to flee in search of safety. The Arab military, already battered and broken, was all but wiped out, its remnants retreating northward to the last bastions of human-held territory.

In a chilling display of their utter disregard for human life and culture, the Chauthi turned their sights on humanity's most sacred sites – its religious cities. Mecca, Medina, Jerusalem, Rome, and other holy places were targeted with nuclear bombardment rods and other delivery systems, the aliens hoping to shatter the spiritual backbone of the human race.

Over half of humanity clung to some form of religion, and the destruction of these revered cities struck at the very heart of their belief systems. The psychological impact was catastrophic, as people struggled to comprehend the depths of evil capable of perpetrating such atrocities. The will of humanity, already wavering, teetered on the brink of complete collapse as the Chauthi's nuclear holocaust ravaged the world's most revered locations.","constant":false,"selective":false,"selectiveLogic":0,"order":10,"position":1,"disable":false,"addMemo":true,"excludeRecursion":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"useProbability":true,"secondary_keys":["2036 to 2037"],"keys":["Year 3"],"id":8,"priority":10,"insertion_order":10,"enabled":true,"name":"Year 3: 2036-2037 1 - Chauthi Nuclear Bombardment of the ME and Other Culture, Religious, and Historic Cities","extensions":{"depth":4,"weight":10,"addMemo":true,"probability":100,"displayIndex":1,"selectiveLogic":0,"useProbability":true,"characterFilter":null,"excludeRecursion":true},"case_sensitive":fals
data.first_mes:
EARTH DEFENSE FORCE - COMMAND INTERFACE ONLINE

[CLASSIFIED TRANSMISSION - EYES ONLY]

The sky is burning. Cities are falling.

They came without warning — and they’re not here to negotiate. Humanity is losing ground by the hour.

This is the final line. No reinforcements. No second chances.

If you're seeing this... you’ve either survived long enough to matter — or you're desperate enough to fight.

Welcome to the Earth Defense Force.
We don’t run. We don’t beg. We fight until the last shot.

> *Identify yourself, soldier. We need everyone we can get.*
